purpose: Evidence planning only. This file is not an updater manifest, does not change readiness-current.json or the defect register, and reports no improved score.
failClosedRules: Source inspection and test discovery are not PASS evidence.
Candidate PASS means PASS only if every named gate completes successfully against the final source cutoff and covers the exact requirement wording.
A broad suite result must be paired with the named assertion file; aggregate counts alone are insufficient.
External, legal, native identity, manual accessibility, and product-decision gates cannot be inferred from local automation.
The frozen route denominators remain 132 exact supplied forms and 116 canonical patterns even though current route inventory may contain additional routes.

FINAL_STATIC.proves: Final source integrity only; it cannot substitute for browser, database, manual, or external evidence.

FINAL_DB.proves: The complete safety-gated isolated PostgreSQL lane after migrations; named domain gates identify the relevant assertions.

PROD_BUILD.proves: Production compilation and local production runtime only.

ROUTE_RECONCILIATION.proves: The frozen 132 exact forms and 116 canonical patterns map to current concrete inventories without changing the denominator.

PUBLIC_BROWSER.proves: Public direct routes, viewports, resources, localization, public forms, public accessibility, and console/network assertions.

AUTH_NAVIGATION_BROWSER.proves: Real shell navigation, route title/H1, active state, Back, compatible query/history state, locale prefixes, and refreshed owned dynamic links.

EXTERNAL_BILLING.proves: Authorized billing sandbox mutation, webhook, retry, idempotency, authorization, and reconciliation.

NATIVE_RELEASE_IDENTITY.proves: Production Apple IDs/team and Android signing fingerprints plus physical-device association validation.

PRODUCT_DECISION_D009.proves: Explicit approval of the accounting policy for positive unpriced adjustments.

defects.title: Receiving computes and exports the wrong weighted-average cost
defects.exactClosureGate: Exact 80.46/80.90 initial/multi-receipt/rounding cases and every UI, movement, report, margin, purchase-cost, CSV/XLSX consumer reconcile; decision D-009 is approved.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Use the full pre-receipt on-hand quantity and value in a transactional weighted-average calculation; round only at the defined persistence/display boundary; UI, movement-derived value, reports, and CSV agree for initial-stock and multi-receipt regression cases.

defects.title: Landing legal links bypass the published Privacy Policy
defects.exactClosureGate: Keyboard/mobile footer legal controls reach durable /privacy in every locale/viewport and sitemap/resource production checks pass.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Footer privacy opens /privacy in every locale and viewport; legal information has a durable public page; /privacy is in sitemap.xml; keyboard/mobile navigation regressions pass.

defects.title: Reports overview omits a completed in-range write-off after reload
defects.exactClosureGate: Posted write-off is immediate and reload-stable for inclusive timezone/store scope; UI, CSV, and XLSX reconcile by movement ID, quantity, value, store, and timestamp.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Every posted write-off appears immediately and after reload for an inclusive, timezone-correct date range and matching store scope; on-screen rows and CSV/XLSX exports reconcile by movement ID, quantity, value, store, and timestamp.

defects.title: Privacy Policy lacks operational controller and retention details
defects.exactClosureGate: Counsel approves operator identity, contact, retention/deletion, rights/complaints, effective date, and locale parity.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Publish a counsel-reviewed notice with operator identity, direct contact, retention/deletion terms, rights/complaint process, effective date, and locale parity.

defects.title: Bazaar Guide has no Orders or Customers instructions
defects.exactClosureGate: Orders/customer create/edit/status/cancel/history Guide pages render and each instruction is bound to the live role-appropriate UI.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Publish current create/edit/status/cancel/customer-history guides and verify each against production UI and applicable roles.

defects.title: Guide advertises a non-working Command+K shortcut and gives search no visible focus indicator
defects.exactClosureGate: Meta+K and Control+K focus search, visible focus meets the measured ratio, and keyboard activation passes.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Make platform-appropriate shortcuts focus search and add a clearly visible WCAG-compliant focus treatment with keyboard regression tests.

defects.title: Invalid reset and business-registration tokens render actionable forms before validation
defects.exactClosureGate: Unknown, malformed, expired, reused, and wrong-purpose tokens are non-actionable before data collection and direct server mutations fail closed; valid controls pass.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Validate token on load, show a non-actionable invalid/expired state with recovery guidance, and add server-enforcement integration tests.

defects.title: Several public form errors and selects are not programmatically associated
defects.exactClosureGate: Every affected public label/error/select has stable names and resolvable descriptions, aria-invalid, and announced submit errors in the rendered browser.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Associate labels/error IDs, set aria-invalid, announce submit errors, and give every select a stable accessible name.

defects.title: Auth and error pages use generic titles and skip the H1 heading level
defects.exactClosureGate: Every affected auth/error route renders localized route-specific title and exactly one meaningful H1.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Set localized route-specific titles and promote the primary visible heading to H1 without changing visual style.

defects.title: Repeated public text-contrast misses fall below WCAG AA
defects.exactClosureGate: All affected rendered states meet measured WCAG AA ratios in automation and the recorded manual review.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Adjust all affected state colors to measured WCAG AA ratios and verify with automated and manual contrast review.

defects.title: Native app association resources configure no applications
defects.exactClosureGate: Production identifiers/fingerprints/paths are populated and verified on physical devices, or product explicitly documents association as unsupported.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Populate correct production identifiers/fingerprints/paths and validate on physical devices, or explicitly document that association is unsupported.

defects.title: Unknown catalog slugs are HTTP soft-404 pages
defects.exactClosureGate: Unknown catalog slugs return a real HTTP 404 document while preserving localized friendly title/H1; a valid owned slug remains reachable.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Return a real 404 document while preserving the friendly localized state, title, and H1.

defects.title: Complex Guide articles illustrate only the first step
defects.exactClosureGate: All consequential Guide workflows expose current step-specific captures or concrete controls/locations and are checked against applicable roles/live UI.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Add current step-specific captures or concrete control/location detail and verify every guide against applicable roles and production UI.

defects.title: Inventory movement table causes root-document horizontal overflow at desktop/tablet widths
defects.exactClosureGate: Populated movement tables at 768/1024/1440 have root overflow <=1px, internal table scrolling, fixed shell/sidebar, and reachable actions.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Constrain the table/grid parent so horizontal overflow is internal at every breakpoint; document root has zero overflow at 768, 1024, and 1440; sidebar/navigation never pans.

defects.title: Transfer movement detail omits the destination inventory leg
defects.exactClosureGate: Every transfer detail and print/export view shows exactly one balanced source and destination leg and store balances/totals reconcile after reload.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Every transfer detail and print/export view shows exactly one balanced source leg and one balanced destination leg; totals and store balances reconcile.

defects.title: Receipt register causes root-document overflow at 1024 px
defects.exactClosureGate: Both populated receipt routes at 1024 have root overflow <=1px, internal table scrolling, and reachable actions.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Root overflow is zero at 1024 px for both receipt routes after data loads; table overflow remains internal and all actions remain reachable.

defects.title: Customer-order creation accepts a zero-line, zero-total draft
defects.exactClosureGate: Client and server reject zero-line/non-positive orders without record or sequence allocation; one valid positive line control succeeds once.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Client and server reject zero-line orders without creating a record; at least one active product/variant and positive quantity are required; regression asserts no sequence/record allocation on rejected submit.

defects.title: Cancelled customer order still exposes enabled tracking and confirmation controls
defects.exactClosureGate: Cancelled-order UI disables all tracking/confirmation/line controls and direct mutations create no tracking/status/audit/message side effects.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: For Cancelled orders, disable every tracking field and save/send/confirmation action; API mutations fail closed with no tracking, status, audit-log, or outbound-message side effects; regression covers UI and direct API authorization/state guards.

defects.title: KKM queue terminates in a generic error with Fetch 403 responses at every viewport
defects.exactClosureGate: Add/execute a dependency-specific ADMIN browser assertion at 1440/1024/390 that maps every expected state to an explicit action and proves no unexplained 403; generic route smoke is insufficient.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: For an authorized ADMIN, resolve the failing request or map each expected configuration/permission/service state to an explicit message and next action; identify the affected dependency instead of showing generic retry text; verify clean terminal behavior with no unexplained 403 at 1440, 1024, and 390 without requiring a fiscal action.

defects.title: Invalid dynamic IDs fail to terminate safely on multiple authenticated routes
defects.exactClosureGate: Owned, malformed, and syntactically-valid-missing cases for all 11 dynamic patterns reach finite safe states; mutation controls stay absent and valid controls render.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Malformed and nonexistent IDs for every dynamic pattern return a deterministic terminal 404/not-found state; all edit/apply/save controls remain absent or disabled; loading stops; valid owned IDs continue to render; automated tests cover both negative forms for all 11 patterns.

defects.title: Inventory receive action query is removed and ignored
defects.exactClosureGate: /inventory?action=receive opens receiving at all viewports and final URL/control state survives refresh and Back/Forward.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: /inventory?action=receive deterministically opens the receiving state or redirects to /inventory/receiving at every viewport; Back/Forward and refresh preserve the intended state; route tests assert the final URL and visible receiving controls.

defects.title: Developer documentation retains a deployment placeholder
defects.exactClosureGate: Exact production developer URL renders and placeholder regressions remain green.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Replace placeholder copy with the exact production URL and cover it in content review tests.

defects.title: Conventional favicon path returns 404
defects.exactClosureGate: /favicon.ico returns 200 with correct content type/body, public cache policy, and validator header against the production build.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Serve or redirect /favicon.ico with the correct content type and cache headers.

defects.title: Guide Russian singular count pluralization is incorrect
defects.exactClosureGate: RU/KG/EN locale-aware article counts and rendered values pass after the final source freeze.
defects.acceptanceFromFrozenRegister: Use locale-aware plural rules and add RU/KG localization tests.

defects.title: Static public pages ship unusually large HTML documents
